text.tspan: Monthly sea surface temperature anomalies relative to the pre-industrial
The difference of average sea surface temperatures compared to the mean from 1861-1890, in degrees Celsius. This is
measured at a depth of 20 centimeters.
Data source: Met Office Hadley Centre - Hadley Centre's Sea Surface Temperature (HadSST) (2026)
Note: The period 1861–1890 is used as the baseline to measure temperature changes relative to pre-industrial times, as recommended by
